5aaf2d.title: CloudMate — tech stack, auth model, and full endpoint map
5aaf2d.content:
## Target: https://cloudmate.onrender.com/ — "CloudMate — AI Cloud Workspace"

### Tech stack (observed)
- Frontend: single-page app, single inline `<script type="module">` (no separate JS bundles yet — confirm). Firebase JS SDK 10.14.1 (gstatic). Google Fonts.
- Backend: `x-render-origin-server: gunicorn` → Flask (Python). Session cookie is Flask-signed: `session=eyJzZXNzaW9uX2lkIjoiMWUwMGRlZDMtMzNiNi00NDczLWExYmItMTFiMzAwMDQ5MDI3In0...` (base64 JSON `{"session_id":"<uuid>"}` + itsdangerous signature). HttpOnly, Path=/, NO Secure/SameSite flags observed.
- Hosting: Render (onrender.com) behind **Cloudflare** (`Server: cloudflare`, cf-cache-status DYNAMIC). No WAF product detected beyond CF.
- Firebase web config (public by design, but note): apiKey AIzaSyCwSUrUXe_TGHrKjOXOtkiVRjuwKfLgGLs, authDomain cloudmate-bf41d.firebaseapp.com, projectId **cloudmate-bf41d**, appId 1:904646474348:web:5f28810e9d4d2c3f9e7649. Firebase Auth email/password enabled.

### Auth model
- **Client-side Firebase email/password auth** → user gets Firebase ID token (JWT) → sent as `Authorization: Bearer <idToken>` to Flask backend for every API call. Backend presumably verifies token against project cloudmate-bf41d.
- Flask session cookie holds only a `session_id` UUID (no user data visible).
- No roles visible; single user tier. Registration appears open (client calls createUserWithEmailAndPassword directly).

### API endpoints (from inline JS, unauthenticated tested next)
| Endpoint | Method | Auth | Body/Params |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/` | GET | none | SPA page |
| `/login`, `/register` | client-side Firebase only | — | (no server routes observed in JS) |
| `/new-chat` | POST | Bearer | {} |
| `/chat` | POST | Bearer | {message, session_id} |
| `/history` | GET | Bearer | → {conversations:[{session_id, created_at, updated_at}]} |
| `/history/{session_id}` | GET | Bearer | → {messages:[{user_message, timestamp, ...}]} |
| `/documents` | GET | Bearer | → {documents:[...]} |
| `/documents/{document_id}` | DELETE | Bearer | |
| `/upload` | POST | Bearer | multipart FormData field `file`; 422 response has `cloud_related:false` + message (server filters non-cloud-related files) |

### Candidate risk areas (recon-level)
1. **IDOR on `/history/{session_id}` and `/documents/{document_id}`** — object IDs user-controlled; needs validation that backend enforces UID ownership (JS comments claim it does).
2. **Bearer token verification** — does Flask actually verify the Firebase ID token on every route, or trust client? Check for auth bypass on POST/GET endpoints.
3. **File upload (`/upload`)** — extension/content-type validation, path traversal in filename, "cloud-related" filter bypass.
4. **`/chat` message content** — LLM prompt injection / response handling; message stored in Firestore.
5. **Flask session cookie** unsigned flags — secret strength, fixation.
6. **CORS / security headers** — not yet checked.
